notes: seat and straps are skinned to Torso (the back just behind the shoulders), the neck strap and its leads blend to Neck; rider_offset is the rider armature root relative to Torso in Blender's imported bone frame, column-major; rider_in_mount (added by mount_to_model_space.py) is the same pose in the mount's glTF model space and is what the game uses
rider_in_mount_note: rider armature root in the mount's glTF model space (Y-up), mount rest pose; preferred over rider_offset
